title: A Structured Analysis of Journalistic Evaluations for News Source Reliability
reasoning: The paper's core subject is the evaluation and comparison of two frameworks (NewsGuard and GDI) designed to assess the reliability of news sources. These frameworks are explicitly based on principles of 'good journalism,' which are a set of professional ethical standards concerning credibility, transparency, fairness, and accuracy. Therefore, the paper is fundamentally a structured analysis of applied media ethics and the methodologies used to evaluate them.
